summary: Added a Linux target settings override to the SPEAR project config so Linux packages remove the inherited SF_VULKAN_SM5 target and cook/run only SF_VULKAN_SM6 for the hardware ray tracing validation path. Included bEnableRayTracing=True because UE 5.5 Linux UBT reads it from /Script/LinuxTargetPlatform.LinuxTargetSettings as Engine config.
work_completed: Updated cpp/unreal_projects/SpearSim/Config/DefaultEngine.ini near the existing target platform settings with [/Script/LinuxTargetPlatform.LinuxTargetSettings].

Set -TargetedRHIs=SF_VULKAN_SM5 and +TargetedRHIs=SF_VULKAN_SM6 so the project overrides Unreal's BaseEngine.ini Linux default and cannot silently package the SM5 Vulkan shader platform for this path.
Added bEnableRayTracing=True under the Linux target settings section; local UE 5.5.4 source confirms UBT supports bEnableRayTracing as LinuxTargetPlatform.LinuxTargetSettings config.

Preserved existing RendererSettings hardware RT CVars, flashlight runtime controls, and unsupported-RT guards; no recook, package, long Unreal run, Git action, or engine source/config edit was performed.
Verification: git diff --check -- cpp/unreal_projects/SpearSim/Config/DefaultEngine.ini passed with no output.
Verification: rg confirmed lines 264-267 contain the LinuxTargetSettings section, -TargetedRHIs=SF_VULKAN_SM5, +TargetedRHIs=SF_VULKAN_SM6, and bEnableRayTracing=True.
Verification: awk static validation reported linux_section_sm5_removals=1 linux_section_sm6_additions=1 linux_section_raytracing_true=1 linux_section_sm5_additions=0.

findings.message: This config change makes Linux BuildCookRun resolve TargetedRHIs to SF_VULKAN_SM6 instead of the inherited BaseEngine.ini SF_VULKAN_SM5 default, so the next clean cook/package should stage VULKAN_SM6 shader artifacts such as Engine/GlobalShaderCache-VULKAN_SM6.bin.

Runtime hardware RT is not validated by this Builder task because the packet explicitly prohibited recook/package/long Unreal jobs. Tower should route clean cook/package and runtime log validation next.

follow_up_recommendations: Have Experimenter perform a clean Linux cook/package and verify VULKAN_SM6 shader autogen/global shader cache artifacts are staged with no VULKAN_SM5 fallback.
After runtime validation succeeds, update user-facing docs to mention the Linux hardware RT packaging prerequisite and expected VULKAN_SM6 startup log signatures.
